test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-6) Official paper (Held On: 9 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Name a low-cost ventilator equivalent to commercially available high-end ventilators developed by the Vikram Sarabhai Space Centre (VSCC) of Indian Space Research Organisation in May 2021.
solution:
The correct answer is __**VaU.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **VSCC** had developed **three different types of ventilators and an oxygen concentrator** at a time when a shortage of this critical medical equipment resulted in the deaths of many** Covid-19 **patients across the country.
 
• Based on designs, features, and specifications, they named them,** Prana, VaU, and Svasta.**
 
• All three are** user-friendly, fully automated, and with touch-screen specifications,** meeting all safety standards

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• ** Vikram Sarabhai Space Centre**

 
 
• It is a major space research center of the **Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)** responsible for the** design and development of launch vehicle technology.**
 
• Vikram Sarabhai was regarded as the** father of the Indian space program.**
 
• It is located in **Thiruvananthapuram (Kerala).**
